summary: Describes a DNS record type that says which host may act as a key exchanger for another host. It is meant to be used only with Secure DNS, so the delegation can be trusted. It is informational.

eli5.summary: It is a note in the Internet's phone book saying, if you need to swap secret keys with me, talk to this other computer.
